paragraphs: Rave Mobile Safety sells the Rave Mobile Safety Suite, software for improving emergency preparedness, response and communication for an organization and the people it protects. The page places the Rave Suite inside the Motorola Solutions safety and security ecosystem.

Rave Alert is described as a FedRAMP-authorized mass notification system sending multimodal messages in three clicks. Rave Panic Button is for rapid communication in an emergency, connecting on-site personnel and first responders at the same time. Rave 911 Suite is offered for 911 operations, with caller profiles, enhanced location data and a functional needs registry.

Industries listed for the suite include law enforcement, education, healthcare, hospitality and retail. The page says the suite helps protect some of the largest communities, companies, and colleges and universities. Testimonials on the page are attributed to a county central dispatch director, a school district superintendent and a county emergency communication operator.

quote.text: The right technology can help people be safer where they live, work, learn and play.
